company.shortDescription: Platform Science provides telematics and fleet management solutions to enhance operations and driver experiences.
company.description: Platform Science is an enterprise-grade IoT fleet management platform for the new era of connected trucks, freight, and the digital supply chain. Since its launch in 2015, Platform Science has spent thousands of hours working with fleets to make transportation smart. The company is based in San Diego, California, United States.

aiResearchSummary.text: Platform Science is researching secure wireless networks for vehicles, dynamic wireless connection management, and remote mobile device management, as described in titles such as Secure Wireless Networks For Vehicles and Remote Mobile Device Management. Their work includes methods for generating standardized vehicle data, identifying and mitigating problematic devices, and micro-navigation for vehicles. These areas focus on enhancing telematics, fleet management, and operational efficiency.
